title: Chapter 174: Seeking The Underworld Again
content:
Chapter 174: Seeking The Underworld Again

Practicing the Nine Changes of the Silkworm, although it still requires a certain amount of accumulation to quickly increase the star level on the battlefield, it is much better than the Zerg combat arms that are constantly exploited by the system, and it is relatively easier to increase the star level.

The energy and luck of the enemies killed by the Zerg combat arms are taken away by the system, and they can only obtain a little luck that must be obtained under the protection of the world rules, so their natural star upgrade is very difficult, and they need to kill a large number of enemies to accumulate luck.

But the Zerg has an advantage. As long as Wu Qing agrees, they can be upgraded to a higher star level at any time, without accumulation, and can continuously upgrade multiple stars, which can be called cheating.

The soldiers who practice the Nine Changes of the Silkworm, the enemies killed on the battlefield, under the causal relationship, the system can also convert the enemy's physical energy, but they are not the direct troops of the Zerg, and the causal relationship is not deep.

Under the protection of the world rules, they will gain more luck, so it is much easier to upgrade the star level than the natural upgrade of the Zerg.

There is no need to worry about the promotion of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations in Daxia Territory and the Alliance. As long as everyone sees the power of this technique, they will naturally know how to choose.

After all, in this world, strength is the most important.

The promotion within the control of the Zerg does not require the participation of Zergmen. The real task of Zergmen is to ride on Zerg warhorses and go out, like human wanderers, to travel between various territories in the hinterland of the native camp, to take themselves as an example, to promote the reputation of the Zerg, and to promote the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations in the most appropriate way.

Wu Qing spent a lot of resources to hatch 100 Zergmen and 100 Zerg warhorses, 10 Zergmen and 10 Zerg warhorses were upgraded to two stars, and 90 Zergmen and 90 Zerg warhorses were upgraded to one star.

One two-star Zergman led nine one-star Zergmen as a team, riding Zerg warhorses of corresponding star levels, and transformed into human cavalry, a total of 10 teams.

These 10 teams of Zerg cavalry will carry enough silkworms to the hinterland of the native camp in the northwest, and explore the specific implementation plan of the "Silkworm Plan" under the real-time guidance of Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg.

After summarizing a set of effective implementation plans, according to the development of the Zerg's own strength, Zerg cavalry teams of corresponding size will be sent to exert influence on various territories of the native camp.

For each team of 10 people, Wu Qing prepared a simple Qiyun array for them. In addition to the silkworms, the Qiyun array and a small amount of Qiyun beads, they don't need to carry anything.

As Zerg, they don't need logistical supplies. They are born with biological colonization suits. They don't need weapons, equipment, full-body clothing and various tools. They can become whatever they want.

It is very convenient for Zerg to travel far.

When encountering irresistible dangers, the Queen of Zerg can come to protect them at any time. When they need it, they can also transmit energy and Qi resources through the Zerg network, directly evolve and upgrade stars on the spot, and deal with various situations with stronger strength.

As long as they don't encounter too strong a crisis, their safety is basically worry-free. If they really encounter irresistible dangers, their losses will not have much impact on the Zerg.

...

Wu Qing arranged the Naga support troops and the preliminary work of the "Tiancan Plan" for tomorrow's expedition, and then consciously possessed the three-star strength of the Zerg clone to feel the combat power that three-star strength can exert.

His original strength cannot break through to two stars for the time being. This is mainly because the system absorbs the luck of Daxia Territory too much. Daxia Territory now has no luck except basic luck.

The Zerg territory is covered by the system, and the world rules cannot perceive it. It only regards the Zerg territory as part of Daxia Territory. The development of the Zerg territory is not recognized by the world rules.

In the eyes of the world rules, Daxia Territory plus Zerg territory is equal to only Daxia Territory. Daxia Territory has less overall luck, and Wu Qing, as the lord, certainly cannot improve his strength.

Last time, in order to solve the food problem of Daxia Territory, the protection range of the lord of Daxia Territory was adjusted, and the luck converted from the system was used.

Wu Qing deliberately did this. His main body often stayed in the Zerg territory. Safety was not a problem. The difference in strength between one star and two stars did not make any difference to him. For the time being, he still had to focus on developing the Zerg.

The Zerg wars have been continuous recently, so he didn't have much time to consider the problems of Daxia Territory. When the Zerg develops, Daxia Territory will naturally follow.

Wu Qing looked at the situation in the Zerg underground territory again, and seeing that everything was very calm, he went to rest.

…

At dawn the next day, more than 240,000 Zerg troops supporting the Naga tribe set out.

The only transport host of the Zerg accompanied it. It activated the three-star talent of reducing the sense of presence. This huge monster flew in the air, and in the eyes of other creatures, it was as if it did not exist.

100 Zergmen who are carrying out the "Silkworm Plan" are carrying their own Zerg warhorses and bags transformed from biological colonization suits filled with mung bean-sized silkworms.

They set out in teams of 10 and will go to the hinterland of the native camp according to the experience of human wanderers, as the forerunners of the "Silkworm Plan", to explore various practical implementation plans.

The Zergmen rode on Zerg warhorses and quickly left the Zerg territory and ran out of the Zerg's actual control area.

In the Zerg's actual control area during the day, there are Zerg puppies active and lurking, forming a strict monitoring network to control all movements in the actual control area.

The Zerg Queen has also been dispatched several times to release parasitic reconnaissance parasites on some creatures in the actual control area to continue to improve this monitoring network.

Through monitoring of creatures active during the day, Wu Qing found that these diurnal creatures would also return to fixed places to rest at night, and the weirdness at night would not attack them.

Apart from this, nothing valuable has been found yet.

In the eastern part of the Zerg controlled area, the Zerg puppy used the occupied strongholds to continue to scout eastward and found that many of the original strongholds of the evil god camp were deserted and abandoned.

After losing the important garrison city on the front line, the evil god camp should have realized the risks of these forward pioneering strongholds. Now they are retreating on their own initiative. There should be another gathering place of the evil god army further east.

The evil god camp will use these gathering places to reorganize the defense line and guard against the counterattack of the local camp.

The Zerg puppy increased the reconnaissance in the east and needed to find out the deployment of the evil god camp as soon as possible so that the Zerg could launch a counterattack.

The Zerg counterattack is not a joke.

…

In the Naga territory, after a night of cleaning, the battlefields of the two wars in which the Zerg reinforcements participated have been cleared, and the Naga tribe has harvested a large amount of combat supplies, which are almost all brought by the bear goblins.

After a night of rest, all the Zerg puppies have recovered to their peak state. Naga should have heard that the Zerg uses energy coins to recover from consumption and injuries, so she had a large number of energy coins delivered last night.

Host No. 3 accepted all of them and distributed them to the Zerg puppies, who absorbed and converted them into system energy.

Because it was agreed that they would wait for the second batch of Zerg reinforcements, Naga led the main force of the Naga tribe to wait with the Zerg army, and the other territorial troops of the Naga tribe were responsible for transporting supplies back to the territory.

Nagalong used the time to wait for the second batch of Zerg reinforcements to continue to go to the nearby large territories to prepare for the luck beads, and strive to give enough luck beads to the Zerg this time, so as not to let the Naga tribe owe too many favors.

The Zerg puppy will rush to the place in about three hours. It will be early by then, and the Zerg can ask the Naga tribe to take them to the front battlefield to take a look.

…

Daxia Territory and Guangfu City are still mainly for construction, and Wu Qing does not need to worry about it. He tasted the sweetness in the underground world yesterday, and now his main energy is still on the underground world.

If the Zerg wants to re-enter the underground world, the first thing to solve is the problem of the evil eye.

Through the actual test yesterday, he found that the attack of the evil eye is threatening to a certain extent, but its attack power is still relatively weak. If ordinary dragons are forced to withstand it, it is not a problem to hit it ten or twenty times.

It is not cost-effective to use the Zerg troops that consume gas resources to compete with the evil eye. The most cost-effective way for the Zerg is to use the puppies to compete with the consumption.

The Zerg puppies' current defense ability is not weaker than that of the dragons, and they can withstand the attack of the evil eye. As long as the various troops cooperate well, it is not a big problem to deal with the evil eye.

Wu Qing gathered a flying dragon, a hydralisk, a puppy, and all the queens, creeping spiders, and explosive mosquitoes, and under the personal leadership of Wu Qing's insect clone, came to the platform outside the underground world barrier.

Two three-star hosts, No. 1 and No. 2, are already here. They are the strongest observers of the underground world and the first to rush here to observe.

After a night of changes, the ghoul territory area on the platform has almost become a nest of evil eyes. Looking around, it is all about one meter in diameter. Evil eyes are densely packed and there is no end in sight.

Their thin tentacles support their round and big eyes, and they look a little weak.

Some of them are resting, some are walking around, and their movement speed is relatively slow.

Wu Qing's insect clone came to the edge of the platform and saw that many evil eyes were arrogantly gathered in the area near the platform. These areas are within the range of the Zerg long-range troops.

The barrier of this underground world is very magical. People from outside can enter and exit, and can also launch long-range attacks from outside.

But people from inside cannot see the outside and cannot exit. Any attacks launched from outside are like hitting the void, disappearing and unable to reach outside the barrier.

Knowing this, Wu Qing certainly would not be polite and directly ordered the Zerg Hydralisk to attack the evil eye within the range.

Led by a three-star hydralisk and more than two thousand one-star hydralisks, 30,000 hydralisks formed a formation and simultaneously launched an attack on the evil eye near the barrier of the underground world.

The mixed attack of the Zerg biodegradable liquid and the Zerg armor-piercing spikes was an overflow attack on the evil eye with very weak defense. After only one round of attack, all the evil eyes within the attack range of the Zerg Hydralisk disappeared.

The stunned evil eye did not know who the enemy was or where the enemy was, and had no way to launch a counterattack.
